work.title: Cantate ved Universitetets Sörgefest over Kong Christian VIII
Cantata at the University's Mourning Ceremony for King Christian VIII
Kong Christian har sit Folk forladt

history.p: King Christian VIII (1786-1848) had died on 20 January, but the mourning ceremony at the University did not take place until 15 march.

termList.term: Music for vocal soloists and instruments with or without choir

incipText.p: Kong Christian har sit Folk forladt
Kongen var en Mand, det Ord skal lyde indtil fjerne Slægt med Sandheds Røst
Høit stod han stillet paa Fjeldet
Døden har vundet, Livet har tabt
Ingen var paa Danmarks Herskersæde Musers Yngling som vor tabte Drot
O Konge! Din Fader i Døden gik

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in purple cardboard with label in Hartmann's hand: "Cantate / ved Universitetets Sörgefest / over Kong Christian VIII. / d: 15 de Marts 1848. / Text af J.L. Heiberg. / Partitur. [added in pencil:] Op 47.". Written in brown ink. Paper: 20 staves. Sporadic pagination in Hartmann's hand. Pagination in pencil in foreign hand at top and bottom of each page. Above the first stave on p. 2: "beg. 25 Febr. 48". P.age 45 blank. Cancellations on pp. 18, 26, 47-48 and 63. On p. 76 end-dated: "I:P:E: Hartmann / d. 11 Marts 1848. / Op.: 47."
